import pandas as pd

def load_and_transform_source(file_path):
    # Load source CSV
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Normalize column names to lowercase to match target schema
    df.columns = [col.lower() for col in df.columns]
    
    # Normalize user_id to lowercase to match target examples style
    if 'user_id' in df.columns:
        df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].str.lower()
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['user_id', 'email', 'geo']
    expected_cols = ['user_id', 'email', 'geo']
    df = df[expected_cols]
    
    return df

def main():
    # List of source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/test_0.csv"
        # Add more source files here if needed
    ]
    
    # Load and transform all sources, then concatenate
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = load_and_transform_source(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)
    
    # Concatenate all source dataframes
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
